notes.title: [Minor Patch] System Stabilization & UI Improvement Update Notice
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
This is the <Accidentally> development team!

First of all, we'd like to sincerely thank everyone who played the demo and provided valuable feedback. 
Based on these inputs, we have made some changes and improvements.

[h3]✍️ What has been improved:
- Added simplified and traditional Chinese logos
- Fixed issues with applying BGM settings
- Adjusted the mouse-over effect for the back button in the options menu
- Fixed auto-progress crash issue when opening the log/save pop-up during auto mode
- Fixed the issue where progress continued despite hide mode
- Updated a few scripts and illustrations[/h3]

While these are minor updates, we prepared them to provide a better gameplay experience for the players. 
We'll continue to listen to your feedback and make steady improvements in the future.

Thank you for playing!

Sincerely, 
<Accidentally> Development Team
